An Event's result fills Løpsresultater · #670

Chosen: Måltrun 112 decisions2 one-way doorsrisk: Annen 10 loses racePace until snappedunattended: one variant

Målt: the Event page's result section becomes the place the result lives. When the writer can save a time, it shows the time large, pace and distance beside it, Målt av klokka · Garmin Forerunner 265 by the figure, and one line saying what the time does to the plan. When it can't, the same place says why in the athlete's words and offers the one fix the page can make: choosing the race's distance.

VariantMålt Chosen

GainA done Event without a distance, or with the wrong one, is fixed where the athlete is looking at the missing result. One tap on a pill, then Lagre.

Held: 120-character name and long place wrap in full; a 51-character Garmin device wraps under the icon; a 6:58:41 marathon and a 13:45:10 100 km fit at 320 px. No overflow at 320, 390 or 1440.

StatusChosen

Decisions

  • Where does a done Event get its distance? In its result section: "Hvor langt var løpet?" with the six anchors and Annen, then Lagre distansen. The Edit page stays for planned Events.
  • How is the Event Distance chosen in the form? A row of pills (1500 m · 3 km · 5 km · 10 km · Halvmaraton · Maraton · Annen), optional, a second tap clears it; Annen opens a km field. It shows only for Løp/Testløp with Idrett exactly Løping, and opens and closes with motion-collapse.
  • What happens to a stored distance when the field hides? Saving clears it (and the writer removes the result), so a hidden field never holds a value.
  • How does an Event's result sit in Løpsresultater? Like a typed row, with Målt av klokka and the credit instead of Skrevet inn av deg, and the Event's name as a link where Slett would be. I bruk marks the typed row only when both share an anchor and a day; the Event row then says why it is not used.
  • What does the result say about the plan? One line: "Øktene med 10 km-fart regner farten fra denne tida", or why not (a typed time the same day, or a distance that is not a Race Anchor).
  • What does a missing result say? One headline and the cause: "Ingen tid er lagret · Klokka målte 11,4 km, men løpet er 10 km", "Opptaket fra klokka har ingen distanse", "Opptaket er en sykkeltur, ikke løping", "Venter på klokka".
  • Annen km equal to an anchor (10, 21,1, 42,2)? Snaps to that Race Anchor (critic).
  • Can a done Event with a result change its distance? Yes: a quiet "Endre distansen" under the result opens the same pills (critic).
  • What does the racePace line say when a newer result at that anchor exists? "Et nyere resultat på 10 km brukes", linking to Løpsresultater (critic).
  • What does an ineligible Event (not run-only, Datomål) show? No distance ask; the not-run reason names the Recording's discipline from labels (critic).
  • What else does a ±5 % miss offer? "Var løypa 10 km? Skriv tida inn på Løpsresultater." beside Endre distansen (critic).
  • Do racePace targets resolved from a Garmin/Polar result carry the derived credit? Yes, derivedAttributionLines per ADR 0098 §3; one-way, architecture to confirm (critic).
Appendix

Critic's scoring

Recommended Målt: the only variant. It holds 7 of 12 criteria and partly holds 5; none misses. Full critique: evidence:critic.md.

#ScoreWhat I saw
1partlyForm and page hold; a done Event with a result has no way to change its distance (Edit is planned-only)
2holdsNo screen; ±5 % rule modelled, nothing contradicts it
3holdsTime, pace, "Målt av klokka · device" by the figure, on the Event page and in Løpsresultater
4holdsLoad Confidence appears nowhere
5partlyThe racePace line has no state for a newer result at the same anchor
6partlyRemoval holds; changing a done Event's distance has no surface
7holds"Venter på klokka" and "Hvor langt var løpet?" both write later
8partlyReasons hold; "sykkeltur" is hard-coded; an ineligible Event's section is not drawn

10holdsEvent name links to the Event, credit shown, no Slett

12holdsExport work, no screen

Craft: Lagre distansen is enabled on an unchanged choice; the mismatch fix should open with motion-collapse; quieten Se økta/Fjern koblingen while the fix is open. Motion (review-animations): Approve; key the result well and gate .lands to the just-written render; reduced motion keeps opacity only when a collapse closes; use the app's motion-collapse, not margin-top. Needs a real phone: the Annen keyboard on iOS (focus in setTimeout), the decimal comma, the keyboard over the field. Probes: evidence:critic-probe/.

Designer's pick

Designer picked Målt: the athlete sees the missing result on the Event page, so the fix belongs there. The critic agrees. One tension: the critic also points a ±5 % miss to Løpsresultater, because when the course really was 10 km, typing the time is the only honest fix this ticket allows.

Method

Tool: Emil's prototype (prototype-ui, standalone branch), one self-contained HTML file in the app's tokens from app/styles/tailwind.css, Norwegian copy taken from app/utils/labels/events.ts and meg.ts where it already exists. Unattended run, so one variant. Screenshots by Playwright 1.56.1 on Chrome, 390 (isMobile, 2x) and 1440; each run checked for console errors and horizontal overflow (none).

Surfaces drawn: app/routes/training/events.$eventId.tsx (ResultSection, header meta), app/routes/training/__event-form.tsx (new field after Idrett), app/routes/settings/training/resultater.tsx (ResultRow). Credit line from recordingSource in app/utils/source-attribution.ts (ADR 0098 §3).

Domain notes

  • Event Distance is not in GLOSSARY.md; it needs an entry, and Event Result ("the Event itself does not duplicate them") needs amending now that a Performance Result is derived from it.
  • The form's existing target kind is also labelled "Distanse" (under Mål). The two sit in different cards; the Event Distance hint names what it does.

Rejected directions

  • Send a done Event to the Edit page for its distance: the Edit page is planned-only today, and the athlete would leave the missing result to fix it.
  • A Select for the distance, as Løpsresultater's add form uses: hides six of seven choices on a field set once per Event.
  • Showing the result as a row in the linked session card: the time is the Event's headline after the race, so it gets the display step.

Variant: Målt Chosen

Working prototype. Top bar: screen (Løpssiden, Skjemaet, Løpsresultater), the Event page's state, light/dark. Bottom: Demo data / Worst case, and the picker. Try "Gjennomført · løpet mangler distanse" → 10 km → Lagre distansen.

The toggle in the prototype swaps the fixture: a 120-character Event name (the form's limit), a long place, a 51-character Garmin device, a 6:58:41 marathon, a 100 km ultra in Annen. What broke on the first pass and was fixed: the Event link in Løpsresultater overlapped the line above when it wrapped (negative margin; now an inline link with an ::after hit area and the chevron after the last word). Held: names wrap in full, figures never truncate, the I bruk badge never wraps.
